ACT IV OF 2021
BALOCHISTAN ARTS COUNCIL
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2021
An Act to amend the Balochistan Arts Council
Act, 2018 (Act No.XVI of 2018)
[Gazette of Balochistan Extraordinary,
29th March, 2021]
No.
PAB/Legis;V(04)/2021, dated 29.3.2021.--- The Balochistan Arts Council (Amendment) Bill 2021 (Bill No. 04 of
2021), having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 22nd
March, 2021 and assented to by the Governor, Balochistan on 26th March, 2021 is
hereby published as an Act of the Balochistan Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---WHEREAS, it is expedient to amend the
Balochistan Arts Council Act, 2018 (Act No. XVI of 2018) in the manner herein
after appearing.
It is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Balochistan Arts Council (Amendment) Act, 2021.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 8, Act XVI of 2018

PAB/Legis;V(04)/2021, dated 29.3.2021.--- The Balochistan Arts Council (Amendment) Bill 2021 (Bill No. 04 of
2021), having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 22nd
March, 2021 and assented to by the Governor, Balochistan on 26th March, 2021 is
hereby published as an Act of the Balochistan Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---WHEREAS, it is expedient to amend the
Balochistan Arts Council Act, 2018 (Act No. XVI of 2018) in the manner herein
after appearing.
It is hereby enacted as follows:
2. Amendment
of section 8, Act XVI of 2018.---In
the Balochistan Arts Council Act, 2018 (Act No.XVI of 2018), in section 8,-
(a) In
subsection (1) for the words "and six ex-officio members out of whom at
least three shall be renowned cultural activist women" the Word "
other than ex-officio members out of whom at least one member shall be from
each division and out of total non-official members at least 4 members shall be
women" shall be substituted.
(b) In
subsection (4),-
(i) clauses
(d) and (e) shall be omitted;
(ii) for
clause (c), the following shall be substituted;
"(c)
Head of Fine Arts Department of Universities in Balochistan".
